projectDescription: A containerized, real-time fraud detection system for Kipu Pagos, built as a microservices architecture with an explainable neural additive model (NAM), a domain API, a data pipeline, and an Nginx API gateway.
keyFeatures: Real-time fraud scoring via REST API with sub-500ms latency target
Explainable Neural Additive Model (NAM) trained with TensorFlow/Keras and exported to ONNX
Platt calibration with production prior correction for accurate fraud probabilities
Hard-rule blocklist (compliance-grade) with time-aware blacklist crossing
Fallback reservation policy when the inference service is unavailable
Full audit trail: every decision stored with model version, inputs, and reasons
PCI-DSS compliance: full PAN rejected at the API boundary; only masked card accepted
Idempotent data loader with PostgreSQL schema and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with quality gate (ROC-AUC ≥ 0.96, PR-AUC ≥ 0.45)
Docker Compose deployment with nginx API gateway, 2 IA replicas, and health checks
publicApiSurface: POST /api/dominio/evaluar — evaluate a transaction and return a fraud decision
GET /api/dominio/predicciones/{transaccion_id} — replay a specific transaction decision
GET /api/dominio/usuarios — list sample users for the frontend
GET /api/dominio/resumen — system summary (table row counts, decision breakdown)
POST /api/ia/predict — raw inference endpoint (called internally by domain service)
